newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian Q2 GDP 0.7 pct, H1 1.5 pct-official.
newsitem.headline: Latvian Q2 GDP 0.7 pct, H1 1.5 pct-official.

text.p: Latvia's gross domestic product in the second quarter of the year rose 0.7 percent to 706 million lats for a 1.5 percent rise in GDP for the whole of the first-half, the statistics committee said on Tuesday.
"Compared to the previous first half, in the first six months of this year, the GDP volume in comparative prices rose by 1.5 percent," the committee said in a statement.
It said GDP gained 2.3 percent in the first quarter.
Latvia has been trying to overcome an economic downturn that hit it in the wake of a banking crisis last year. GDP in 1995 is estimated to have fallen by around 0.6 percent.
GDP in 1996 is expected to rise by two to three percent, according to International Monetary Fund (IMF) forecasts.
